response.reply: Thank you for letting us know. Could you please provide your booking reference so we can look into the double‑booking? In the meantime, if you’re on the train or at the station, please raise the issue with the staff there – they can check the machine and resolve it on the spot.

To claim delay repay, please use the GWR website or mobile app to submit a delay claim. You’ll need your ticket details and the journey information. Once submitted, our team will review it and process any eligible compensation. If you need help with the claim form, let us know and we’ll guide you through it.

I’m sorry you’re experiencing double‑booking again. Could you please provide your booking reference so we can look into it? In the meantime, you can raise the issue at the station – staff will be able to check the machine and resolve the reservation.
Hello! Thank you for reaching out. If you have any questions or need assistance, just let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

Thank you for letting us know. I’m sorry you experienced a delay and found the facilities in poor condition. I’ve forwarded your feedback to the relevant team so they can look into the service and cleanliness issues. If you’d like to discuss this further, please contact our customer support team via the GWR Help channel.

I’m sorry to hear about the issues you experienced. I can help you raise a formal complaint and discuss any compensation you may be entitled to. Please let me know the train details (date, time, and number) and I’ll forward your concerns to the appropriate team.
I’m sorry, I don’t have that information. Please check the GWR timetable or contact GWR for the latest status.
